column1: # Pokémon Legends: Arceus on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Game Freak's engine on SDK 11.4.0; game.tsv and the shader tables are upstream's, checked by hand. 73 of its 12,851 shaders live only in Oodle Kraken GFPAK entries:
# the porter decodes them with the game's own decoder on the device (dmhost, DM_OODLE_JOB), so a port needs the device connected.
# On the Y700 (2026-10-30), docked and handheld, driven with DM_CTL: the opening (Arceus, the name, the fall), the beach with Laventon and the starters, the first walks.
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch: patches.py), GPU 11-14.6 ms at the beach; a 30-minute soak kept one
# process at a flat 1,307 MiB footprint with no audio underruns and no red log line. The washed-out picture it first had was the vertex outputs' Maxwell start values
# (gfx_vk_shader.c spv_vs_init). Local wireless trades stay offline (nn::ldn cut): Trading Post → Local Communication not checked yet.

column1: # The game steps its time by a stored frame period, not by the clock (patches.py "frame_step"): on the Odin 3 (2026-11-10) the 60 fps cut alone ran everything at double
# speed, and the pause menu's 30 by host pacing (DM_FRAME_CAP_MODE=pace, which this profile had) could not be right at both rates. With game.tsv's fps_target the period
